Compare the loaded Cobra command tree with canonical command specifications
under .zqk/cli/specs. Fails when a static command lacks a specification or a
specification is not wired into the live CLI.

  Validate the default command-spec source of truth
  zqk system validate-command-specs
  Emit full structured coverage diagnostics
  zqk system validate-command-specs --format json --verbose
  Deliberately capture the current historical-drift baseline
  zqk system validate-command-specs --write-baseline

Usage:
  zqk system validate-command-specs [flags]

Flags:
      --baseline string    Override the accepted historical-drift baseline
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --specs-dir string   Override the canonical command-spec directory
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output
      --write-baseline     Replace the baseline with the current measured drift

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
